spec_markdown.description: The product spec: problem statement, user stories, scope in/out. Proportional to ticket size — a small feature gets a small spec.

description.description: Observable, testable behavior through the UI or API

open_questions.description: Real ambiguities a human should settle. Empty if none.

blocking.description: true only if the answer would change an acceptance criterion, the scope boundary, or an API/UI contract — i.e. the design and dev phases would be guessing. A blocking question parks the ticket for a human; nice-to-know questions are false.
